- (agent-platform-backend) [Order session states by candidate on the 0.244 line](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2835) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The backend returns session states newest session first instead of in the order its reads finish, which ends a flaky test that failed pull requests on this line at random.
